text: 标普500指数收涨39.28点，涨幅0.51%，报7743.41点，北京时间00:00前后显著拉升，本周累计上涨1.21%，整体处于上涨状态、呈现出N形走势。 道琼斯工业平均指数收涨478.64点，涨幅0.93%，报51828.62点，本周累涨0.28%，整体实现V形反转。 纳斯达克综合指数（纳指）收涨129.343点，涨幅0.48%，报27068.716点，本周累涨2.06%。 纳斯达克100指数收涨129.278点，涨幅0.42%，报30608.134点，本周累涨3.25%。
text_en: The S&P 500 closed up 39.28 points, or 0.51%, at 7,743.41, rising significantly around 00:00 Beijing time, up 1.21% for the week, overall in an upward state and showing an N-shaped trend. The Dow Jones Industrial Average closed up 478.64 points, or 0.93%, at 51,828.62, up 0.28% for the week, achieving an overall V-shaped reversal. The Nasdaq Composite Index closed up 129.343 points, or 0.48%, at 27,068.716, up 2.06% for the week. The Nasdaq 100 Index closed up 129.278 points, or 0.42%, at 30,608.134, up 3.25% for the week.
